Await this at an asynchronous entry point, then construct providers inside IPreparedProviderCredentials.Activate: var prepared = await resolver.PrepareAsync(ct: ct); using (prepared.Activate()) { // synchronous provider construction } The prepared credentials are a point-in-time read and are only valid for the construction that immediately follows; do not keep them. |

## PollingProviderBase

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.Core.PollingProviderBase</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/PollingProviderBase.cs:23](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/Core/PollingProviderBase.cs#L23).

Abstract base class for polling-based market data providers (REST providers that do not expose a streaming WebSocket API). Consolidates the connection lifecycle, honest connection diagnostics, and degraded-state backoff that would otherwise be hand-rolled per provider — the polling counterpart to WebSocketProviderBase. Derived classes implement the provider-specific poll via PollOnceAsync and report their subscription count via ActiveSubscriptionCount. They may record poll activity through the protected Record* helpers so the shared diagnostics stay accurate.
